name: Magic Show: "Escola de Mágicos"
description: The "School of Magicians" opens its doors this Sunday with a brand new show. Prepare to be amazed by an afternoon of illusion and wonder at this historic Porto theatre.
longDescription:
The "Escola de Mágicos" presents a new magic show at the Teatro Sá da Bandeira. This performance is a production by the "School of Magicians," an institution dedicated to the art of illusion. The show aims to showcase the skills of its performers and introduce audiences to various forms of stage magic.

Attendees can expect an afternoon performance featuring a range of magical acts. The show is designed for a family audience, offering entertainment suitable for different age groups. The Teatro Sá da Bandeira, a historic theatre in Porto, provides a traditional setting for the event. The duration of the show is typical for a theatrical performance.

Tickets are required for entry to this event. The Teatro Sá da Bandeira is located in central Porto, accessible via the Bolhão metro station, approximately a 5-minute walk. Several bus routes also serve the area. The venue is generally accessible, and the event is categorized as family-friendly.
